ValidationRule.description: SS-13637 - Updated the StageNumber value. An opportunity with Type as “POC”, cannot be linked/used in the POC Request(POC Request Object) record in the field “POC Opportunity”(opportunity lookup).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordType.Name = 'Customer: On-Prem', RecordType.Name = 'Customer: Tanium Cloud' ), OR(ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.Type, 'POC'), Opportunity__r.StageNumber__c = 210))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Opportunity linked to this request cannot be in POC Type or Stage.
